analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI settled in neutral territory, MACD showed sustained improvement. Despite today's -9.20% drop, RSI remains at 42.4 in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram improvement continues. Volume ratio at 0.70 (below 5-day average) indicates weak conviction for trend change. ADX at 29.7 suggests a trend, but -DI (31.7) is higher than +DI (20.5), indicating downward pressure. 52-week position at 51.5% is mid-range. Lack of clear direction and subdued volume warrant a continued wait-and-see stance.
